note: China image remediation — verified photo provenance for 10 China destinations (Wuxi baseline + 9 remaining cities). Each flagship attraction and city page uses a locally-hosted WebP derived from a Wikimedia Commons photo whose author, license, and subject-location were individually verified (Commons category / description). Non-flagship entities use no curated image and fall back to the site default. No images are fabricated; no creator or license is ever invented. Creator unknown (hongcun) is marked MEDIUM risk and disclosed.
licenseConvention: All images are Wikimedia Commons CC-licensed; attribution to the recorded author is required per each license.

deliberateExclusions.topic: 非旗舰/未核实景点使用默认图

Liuhe Pagoda material was downloaded and verified but there is no Liuhe Pagoda data entity; it was never mapped to Leifeng Pagoda (a distinct landmark). Deprecated to prevent cross-landmark contamination.
